title: bop Aero Names Elite Aircraft Services Preferred Vision Jet Training Provider
body:
FLORENCE, Ky. — September 18, 2026 — Bop Aero Services LLC (“bop Aero”) today announced that it has selected Elite Aircraft Services, LLC (“Elite”) as the preferred Cirrus SF50 Vision Jet flight training provider for owner-pilots in bop Aero’s shared ownership program. The announcement is made in conjunction with Elite’s release today introducing its SF50 type rating training program.

Under a memorandum of understanding between the companies, Elite will serve as the preferred training provider for SF50 owners participating in bop Aero’s program, covering both initial qualification and recurrent training. bop Aero has also been designated as the commercial launch customer of Elite’s SF50 program.

Elite’s program offers initial and recurrent training in Elite’s own SF50, with the option for training to be conducted in an owner’s aircraft. Owner-pilots can complete initial type training — including time in Elite’s simulator and in-aircraft training — and fulfill their Introduction to Operating Experience (IoE) requirements in 10 days.

“Owners in our shared program need a consistent, high-quality training standard, and Elite’s program and location support that. We believe our owners will enjoy the fully customized program that Elite has designed for them. This program allows an owner to complete their initial type training, which includes time in both their state-of-the-art simulator as well as invaluable in-aircraft training time, and fulfill their IoE requirements in 10 days,” said Raymond Chase, President & CEO, bop Aero.

As part of the relationship, Elite has entered into an options agreement for one or more shares in bop Aero’s program. Elite intends to evaluate that option as a means of supporting long-term aircraft availability for its training clients as the training program continues to expand.

“We’re excited that bop Aero has recognized that our innovative training program can provide real-world training for their owner-pilots. Another part of this agreement that we’re excited about is the ability to offer existing Elite customers a path to Vision Jet ownership that doesn’t require the outright purchase of an entire aircraft through bop Aero,” said Matt Walsh, CEO, Elite Aircraft Services.

Elite Aircraft Services is an aircraft sales, management, and training company based at Raleigh Executive Jetport (KTTA) in Sanford, N.C.

About bop Aero
Bop Aero Services LLC (“bop Aero”) operates a shared ownership program for Cirrus SF50 Vision Jet owner-pilots. Learn more at www.bopaero.com.
